name: W-165 planetary turbolaser
description: The w-165 planetary turbolaser was a heavy turbolaser manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards. At the time of its introduction, it was the most powerful planetary turbolaser ever built, and was four times as powerful as the v-150 Planet Defender .

data.name: w-165 planetary turbolaser
data.crew: 50 (soldiers, technicians, computer operators, engineers, and gunners)
